questions.solution_en:

questions.q_en: Who among the following was the chief guest of India's first Republic Day in 1950?
questions.solution_en:
· Sukarno, the first President of Indonesia, was the chief guest at India's first Republic Day celebrations on 26 January 1950.

· This marked a significant diplomatic gesture, as both countries had recently gained independence (India in 1947, Indonesia in 1945) and were founding members of the Non-Aligned Movement.

Further insight:

· Rana Abdul Hamid - A Pakistani military officer, irrelevant to the 1950 event.

· Georgy Zhukov - Soviet Marshal; first Soviet chief guest in 1955, not 1950.

· Queen Elizabeth - First British monarch to attend R-Day in 1961 (as Queen of the UK and Commonwealth; India had already removed the British monarch as head of state by 1950).

questions.q_en: When is the statehood day of Tripura observed?
questions.solution_en: Statehood Day is celebrated every year as Manipur, Meghalaya, and Tripura on January 21 as they attained statehood under the North Eastern Region (Reorganization) Act of 1971. Earlier before the north-eastern region was turned into seven sisters with the statehood of Manipur, Tripura, Meghalaya, Assam, Mizoram, Arunachal Pradesh, and Nagaland, the North Eastern composition consisted of Assam plains from the old Assam Province, the hill districts, and the North Eastern Frontier Tracts (NEFT) of the North-Eastern borderland.

questions.q_en: In India, Teachers' Day is celebrated annually on September 5 to mark the birthday of:
questions.solution_en:
Teachers' Day is celebrated on September 5 in India to honor Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, a great scholar, philosopher, and the second President of India.

· When his students wanted to celebrate his birthday, he suggested that instead of celebrating his birthday, the day should be dedicated to teachers.

· The first Teachers' Day was celebrated in 1962.

Other options:

· APJ Abdul Kalam - Missile Man of India, his birthday (October 15) is celebrated as World Students' Day.

· Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel - Iron Man of India, his birthday (October 31) is observed as National Unity Day.

· Subhas Chandra Bose - Freedom fighter, his birthday (January 23) is observed as Parakram Diwas.

Hence, option (3) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en: Gurpurab is celebrated to commemorate the birthday of Guru Nanak Dev Ji. He was the _________ guru of Sikhs?
questions.solution_en:
· Guru Nanak Dev Ji (1469 - 1539) was the founder of Sikhism and the first of the ten Sikh Gurus.

· Gurpurab (or Guru Nanak Jayanti) is celebrated to commemorate his birth anniversary.

· He laid the foundation of Sikh teachings, emphasizing equality, devotion to God, and honest living.

Further information:

· Second - Guru Angad Dev Ji was the second Sikh Guru.

· Third - Guru Amar Das Ji was the third Sikh Guru.

· Fourth - Guru Ram Das Ji was the fourth Sikh Guru.

questions.q_en: The birthday of ________ is celebrated as the International Day of Non-Violence.
questions.solution_en:
• The birthday of Mahatma Gandhi is celebrated as the International Day of Non-Violence.

• Mahatma Gandhi (Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi), born on October 2, 1869, in Porbandar, Gujarat, was a leader of India's freedom struggle against British rule, known as the "Father of the Nation."

• Advocating non-violence (Ahimsa) and truth (Satya), he led key movements like the Dandi Salt March (1930) and Quit India Movement (1942).

• His philosophy of Satyagraha (non-violent resistance) inspired global civil rights movements.

• Gandhi was assassinated on January 30, 1948, in New Delhi, leaving a legacy of peace, equality, and self-reliance.

questions.q_en: National Sports Day is celebrated on the birthday of _______.
questions.solution_en:
· National Sports Day is celebrated on 29th August, the birthday of Major Dhyan Chand, one of India's greatest hockey players.

· He is renowned for his extraordinary skills and contributions to Indian hockey, including three Olympic gold medals (1928, 1932, and 1936).

· The day honors his legacy and promotes sports across the country.
